title: Leaks like a sieve
text:
Leaks like a sieve. Update 1 month after purchase: I hadn't used it in a few days because the MOTOR is too loud so I was intending to move it across the room to see if that would help. When I woke up this morning, the humidifier was sitting in a bit puddle of water. When I carried it over to the sink and dumped it out and dried it off with a towel, I could see it was leaking more water out of a hole (or holes) in the bottom of the machine. What's the deal with that? And why did it just start leaking now? It's just dumb luck it didn't get anything else wet besides the metal table it was sitting on. Lucky for me it's within the return window, so I'm returning the humidifier.
----------------
I haven't had this humidifier for very long and so far it's OK. It puts out a lot of mist which is nice. I like how I can turn the blue light completely off, unlike most humidifiers. And I like how I don't have to buy or deal with filters.

The essential oils part--which is a big selling point--is a little useless. I've put up to 5 drops of oils on the sponge ring (the instructions recommend 3 drops) and I still can't detect any oils in the mist. Maybe if I stand right in front of it and blast myself in the face, but even then it's hardly potent enough to smell my oils. Can't say I'm impressed about that.

The only other complaint I have is that the power "button" doesn't work that well. It's less a button and more just a sensor like a touch screen. A poorly performing touch screen. It takes a lot of tries to get it to work so that's pretty annoying.

product_metadata.title: BAYKA Cool Mist Humidifier, 4L Top Fill Ultrasonic Desk Humidifier for bedroom, Portable Essential Oil Humidifiers with Adjustable Mist Output, Works Up to 28 Hours, Auto Shut-off
features: The Best Choice for You -- With 3 mist levels (High/Medium/Low) available for you to choose from, you also have the option of controlling the mist direction. At the touch of your finger, the cool mist humidifier creates the level of humidity you need and delivers mist to every corner of the room.

Designed for Lazy Bones -- The 4L capacity TOP FILL water tank measures at 7" high for an effortless faucet fill and runs for up to 28 hours on a single fill. Our air humidifier automatically Shuts-off when it runs out of water or the water tank is removed.

Deep Sleep Mode –BAYKA bedroom humidifier is fitted with ultrasonic vibrating diaphragms that force tiny drips of water into the air. This feature makes the humidifier quieter than others. Turn off the nightlight by pressing the touch panel for 3s. Enjoy all night mist and rest easily.

Easy to Clean -- The baby humidifiers need to be cleaned regularly to prevent grime and dust build-up in the water tank. The water tank has a flat surface and a 4. 5’’ x 2. 8’’ water inlet that allows you to hand clean and dry the tank to get pure mist.

More than Humidifier -- As our humidifier comes with an Aromatherapy Box, you can drop essential oil on the sponge ring and enjoy the mist and fragrance at the same time (Please note that the essential oil is not included).
